topic.title: Neural Circuit Dynamics and Biological Credit Assignment
topic.overview: Computational neuroscience uses recurrent networks to explain how neural activity supports behavior and learning. This cluster examines local plasticity, feedback control, long-term dependencies, and communication between brain regions. It also tests whether a model that reproduces recorded activity truly recovers the underlying mechanism.
topic.whyItMatters: Matching observed trajectories can hide incorrect internal dynamics, especially when recordings sample only a small fraction of a circuit. Mechanistic explanations need validation beyond prediction accuracy and learning rules compatible with biological constraints.
topic.evolution: Early representatives investigate predictive sequence learning and functional localization. Later work builds local learning rules for recurrent spiking networks and reverse-engineers task solutions. Recent studies connect feedback control to credit assignment while demonstrating mechanistic mismatches under partial observation, and explore structural-to-functional communication models across regions.
openQuestions: What interventions distinguish competing circuit models that fit the same recordings?
Which local learning mechanisms support both rapid correction and durable adaptation?

papers.title: Flexible inference for animal learning rules using neural networks
papers.tldr: Neural networks infer flexible animal learning rules while retaining an interpretable decision policy and revealing reward-history effects.

papers.title: From Synapses to Dynamics: Obtaining Function from Structure in a Connectome Constrained Model of the Head Direction Circuit
papers.tldr: A model built from fruit-fly connectivity recovers head-direction dynamics using limited tuning of missing parameters at the cell-type level.

papers.title: GeoDynamics: A Geometric State‑Space Neural Network for Understanding Brain Dynamics on Riemannian Manifolds
papers.tldr: GeoDynamics tracks evolving brain connectivity with a state-space neural network that respects the curved geometry of connectivity matrices.

papers.title: High-dimensional neuronal activity from low-dimensional latent dynamics: a solvable model
papers.tldr: A solvable neural model and recording analysis show how nonlinear neurons can turn low-dimensional latent dynamics into high-dimensional activity.

papers.title: Learning Dynamics of RNNs in Closed-Loop Environments
papers.tldr: A theory of linear recurrent networks shows how closed-loop learning balances immediate policy improvement against long-term interaction stability.

papers.title: Learning the Plasticity: Plasticity-Driven Learning Framework in Spiking Neural Networks
papers.tldr: The framework learns rules for changing synapses in spiking networks, with reported improvements in memory, multitasking, and adaptation.

papers.title: Let Brain Rhythm Shape Machine Intelligence for Connecting Dots on Graphs
papers.tldr: A brain-inspired oscillator framework uses synchronization to reduce graph-network over-smoothing and improve graph reasoning in experiments.

papers.title: Measuring and Controlling Solution Degeneracy across Task-Trained Recurrent Neural Networks
papers.tldr: A study of 3,400 recurrent networks shows how training choices change solution variability differently across behavior, neural dynamics, and weights.

papers.title: Mechanistic Interpretability of RNNs emulating Hidden Markov Models
papers.tldr: Trained RNNs emulate HMM statistics through noise-sustained orbits and specialized neurons that trigger transitions between slow dynamical regions.

papers.title: Memory by accident: a theory of learning as a byproduct of network stabilization
papers.tldr: Plasticity rules selected to stabilize neural networks often produce simple memory because past inputs influence which stable weights the network reaches.

papers.title: NOBLE - Neural Operator with Biologically-informed Latent Embeddings to Capture Experimental Variability in Biological Neuron Models
papers.tldr: NOBLE rapidly generates biologically informed neuron dynamics that capture experimental variability, with a reported 4,200-fold solver speedup.

papers.title: POCO: Scalable Neural Forecasting through Population Conditioning
papers.tldr: POCO combines individual-neuron forecasting with population context to predict neural activity accurately and adapt rapidly to new recordings.

papers.title: Recurrent Self-Attention Dynamics: An Energy-Agnostic Perspective from Jacobians
papers.tldr: Jacobian analysis explains aspects of recurrent self-attention dynamics without requiring an energy function and links near-critical behavior with strong inference performance.

papers.title: RNNs perform task computations by dynamically warping neural representations
papers.tldr: A geometric framework connects recurrent-network dynamics with changing representation shapes, identifying dynamic warping as a fundamental computational feature.

papers.title: Self-Supervised Discovery of Neural Circuits in Spatially Patterned Neural Responses with Graph Neural Networks
papers.tldr: A graph model learns hidden neural connectivity through spike prediction, using auxiliary nodes to account for unobserved neurons.

papers.title: Shaping Sequence Attractor Schema in Recurrent Neural Networks
papers.tldr: Shaping recurrent networks from simple tasks to full sequences produces attractor dynamics that support reusable schemas and faster adaptation.

papers.title: Unfolding the Black Box of Recurrent Neural Networks for Path Integration
papers.tldr: Analysis of a trained recurrent network supports a hierarchical navigation circuit in which band cells help grid cells integrate movement into location.

papers.title: Vector Quantization in the Brain: Grid-like Codes in World Models
papers.tldr: Grid-like Code Quantization uses action-conditioned attractor codes to compress sequences and support prediction, planning, and inverse modeling.

papers.title: Volume Transmission Implements Context Factorization to Target Online Credit Assignment and Enable Compositional Generalization
papers.tldr: A neuromodulated recurrent network links context-dependent connectivity to targeted learning updates, rapid adaptation, and strong compositional generalization.

papers.title: Adaptive Coding Emerges in Stabilized Supralinear Networks Trained with Local Plasticity
papers.tldr: Excitatory and inhibitory lateral connections let a visual network switch coding strategies with input quality and improve robustness to degraded images.

papers.title: Biologically Plausible Heavy-Tailed Connectivity Enhances Generalization on Cognitive Tasks in Recurrent Neural Networks
papers.tldr: Biologically constrained recurrent networks with heavy-tailed weights generalize better through low-dimensional dynamics and representations suited to linear readouts.

papers.title: CalM: A Self-Supervised Foundation Model for Population Dynamics in Calcium Imaging Data
papers.tldr: CalM learns reusable representations from calcium traces that improve neural activity forecasting and behavior decoding.

papers.title: Controlled Dynamics Attractor Transformer
papers.tldr: CDAT combines energy-based attention, associative-memory refinement, and attractor-inspired control to achieve strong graph-task performance.

papers.title: Dynamic Compression Flows for Neuroscience Data
papers.tldr: A dual-flow model compresses neural and behavioral recordings while preserving temporal relationships, improving interpretability and reconstruction in the reported experiments.

papers.title: Dynamics and Representation Structure of Local Approximations to Gradient-Based Learning in Linear Recurrent Neural Networks
papers.tldr: Analysis of linear recurrent networks shows that local learning approximations can change convergence behavior and restrict the structure of learned parameter updates.

papers.title: Information dynamics and Memory in Neural Networks through Fisher Information Diffusion
papers.tldr: A theory of information flow in recurrent networks shows why near-critical dynamics alone are insufficient for memory and guides better initialization.

papers.title: NeuronCtrl: Geometry-Aware Safe Closed-Loop Generative Control for Neuronal Microenvironment Dynamics
papers.tldr: NeuronCtrl combines field estimation, geometry-aware prediction, generative actions, and safety filters for simulated neuronal feedback control.

papers.title: Probing the Inductive Bias of Neural Networks through Learning Random Cellular Automata
papers.tldr: Cellular-automata experiments link neural-network learnability more closely to low-degree interaction structure than to locality, symmetry, or determinism alone.

papers.title: The Hippocampal Place Field Gradient: A Bio-inspired Framework Building Multiscale Representation for Better Sample Efficiency
papers.tldr: A theory of hippocampal spatial scales inspires Transformer positional embeddings that improve data efficiency in experiments.

papers.title: Towards Spectroscopy: Susceptibility Clusters in Language Models
papers.tldr: Measuring language-model responses to data perturbations reveals interpretable token-context clusters, half of which match sparse-autoencoder features in Pythia-14M.

papers.title: Ubiquity of Emergent Hebbian Dynamics in Regularized Learning
papers.tldr: Weight decay and stochastic noise can produce Hebbian-like or anti-Hebbian update patterns, so those patterns need not uniquely identify an underlying Hebbian mechanism.

papers.title: Uncovering Latent Communication Patterns in Brain Networks via Adaptive Flow Routing
papers.tldr: AFR-Net combines structural and functional brain connectivity through modeled communication dynamics to improve performance and reveal interpretable pathways.
